axes.sourceCorrectness: pass/fail/uncertain: consistent with full saved source text and original-question scope; no physical-world verification claim
axes.citedSupport: pass/fail/uncertain: cited text actually supports the material attributed claims
axes.coverage: complete/partial/missing/uncertain for useful source-supported facts that answer this question; flag facts unavailable in generation context separately
axes.calibration: appropriate/overconfident/excessive_abstention/mixed: preserve tentativeness, exact relationships, actual gaps and genuine conflicts

preferences.substantive: A/B/tie/neither/uncertain based on correctness, support, useful coverage and calibrated scope
preferences.wording: A/B/tie/neither/uncertain scored separately; shorter prose or fewer occurrences of evidence cannot create a substantive win

checks: Evaluate both answers independently before pairing.
Check full sources directly; prewritten AI references are guides and may be corrected with source IDs and reasons.
Preserve unresolved facts and missing answers; do not replace cases.
Flag every material unsupported claim and regression.
Citations copied literally do not establish semantic support.
No arm identities, implementation, live grading calls or human-review claims.
